words.quote: Because of the physical demands required by many sports, career-ending injuries are always a risk. Some athletes work regularly with fitness trainers and instructors to gain muscle and stamina and to prevent injury. They also may work with athletic trainers or exercise physiologists to recover and rebuild from injuries, even minor ones.
Athletes and sports competitors practice under the direction of coaches and sports instructors.

They also may work with athletic trainers or exercise physiologists to recover and rebuild from injuries, even minor ones.

grammar.sentence: Although no formal educational credential is typically required to enter the occupation, most athletes and sports competitors have at least a high school diploma or equivalent.

grammar.sentence: In addition, athletes may have their licenses or certification suspended for inappropriate activity.

words.quote: Musicians and singers play instruments or sing for live audiences and in recording studios. They perform a variety of genres, such as classical, jazz, and rock.

Musicians play solo or in orchestras, bands, or limited-size groups, such as trios. Those in bands or groups may play at small venues, such as private parties or bars, sometimes building enough of a fan base to get a recording contract or representation by an agent. Musicians who work in orchestras perform in venues with a stage large enough to accommodate all the musicians and their instruments. A few orchestra musicians become section leaders, who may be responsible for assigning parts to other musicians or for leading rehearsals.
Audition for positions in orchestras, choirs, bands, and other types of music groups

grammar.sentence: To make themselves more marketable, many become proficient in multiple musical instruments or styles.

grammar.quote: To make themselves more marketable, many become proficient in multiple musical instruments or styles.

grammar.sentence: Auditioning for jobs can be a frustrating process because it may take many different auditions to get hired.

words.quote: Outlays in fiscal year 2024 were reduced because October 1 (the first day of the fiscal year) fell on a weekend. As a result, certain payments totaling $72 billion were shifted from 2024 into 2023. If not for those shifts, the deficit in 2025 would have been 6 percent smaller—instead of 2 percent smaller—than it was in 2024.

In fiscal year 2025, which ended on September 30, the federal budget deficit totaled $1.8 trillion—a decrease of $41 billion (or 2 percent) from the shortfall recorded in the previous year. Revenues and outlays alike increased from 2024 totals. Revenues rose by 6 percent, or $317 billion; increases in collections of individual income taxes and customs duties were partially offset by a decline in corporate tax receipts. Outlays grew by 4 percent, or $275 billion, with increases occurring in several areas, including the largest benefit programs and net interest on the public debt (which, for the first time, surpassed $1 trillion). Those increases were partly offset by decreases recorded for federal student loan programs, deposit insurance, and the Small Business Administration. The 2025 amounts reported here differ somewhat from amounts described in the Monthly Budget Review: September 2025 because they reflect the subsequently reported data in the Monthly Treasury Statement for September 2025.

words.quote: The complete DNA instruction book, or genome, for a human contains about 3 billion bases and about 20,000 genes on 23 pairs of chromosomes.

In organisms called eukaryotes, DNA is found inside a special area of the cell called the nucleus. Because the cell is very small, and because organisms have many DNA molecules per cell, each DNA molecule must be tightly packaged. This packaged form of the DNA is called a chromosome.

To understand DNA's double helix from a chemical standpoint, picture the sides of the ladder as strands of alternating sugar and phosphate groups - strands that run in opposite directions. Each "rung" of the ladder is made up of two nitrogen bases, paired together by hydrogen bonds. Because of the highly specific nature of this type of chemical pairing, base A always pairs with base T, and likewise C with G. So, if you know the sequence of the bases on one strand of a DNA double helix, it is a simple matter to figure out the sequence of bases on the other strand.

grammar.sentence: Because the cell is very small, and because organisms have many DNA molecules per cell, each DNA molecule must be tightly packaged.
grammar.explanation: 两个because并列给出原因：细胞很小，而且每个细胞有许多DNA分子。must be packaged是情态动词加被动，说明DNA必须被紧密包装，不是DNA主动包装别的东西。
grammar.quote: Because the cell is very small, and because organisms have many DNA molecules per cell, each DNA molecule must be tightly packaged.

grammar.sentence: When a cell prepares to divide, the DNA helix splits down the middle and becomes two single strands.
grammar.explanation: When从句说明过程发生的时间条件，主句用一般现在时描述通常过程。prepares to divide中的to divide补充准备做的事；splits与becomes共用主语the DNA helix，不能把单数splits改读成两个细胞先合并。
grammar.quote: When a cell prepares to divide, the DNA helix splits down the middle and becomes two single strands.

words.quote: Researchers at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) have adapted their atom-based radio receiver to detect and display live color television and video games.

Researchers use two different color lasers to prepare gaseous rubidium atoms in Rydberg states in a glass container. The team previously used the setup with cesium atoms to demonstrate the basic radio receiver and a “headphone” appliance to boost sensitivity a hundredfold.

NIST’s receiver uses atoms prepared in high-energy “Rydberg” states, which are unusually sensitive to electromagnetic fields, including radio signals. These sensors also enable signal power measurements linked to the international system of units (SI). The latest work, described in AVS Quantum Science, is the first to demonstrate video reception.

grammar.sentence: Atom-based communications systems are of practical interest because they could be physically smaller and more tolerant of noisy environments than conventional electronics.
grammar.explanation: because给出实际意义的原因；smaller和more tolerant...than作并列比较，比较对象是传统电子设备。could保留潜力和可能性，不能改写成所有产品现在都更小、更耐噪。
grammar.quote: Atom-based communications systems are of practical interest because they could be physically smaller and more tolerant of noisy environments than conventional electronics.

words.quote: Psychotherapy (also called talk therapy) refers to a variety of treatments that aim to help a person identify and change troubling emotions, thoughts, and behaviors. Most psychotherapy takes place one-on-one with a licensed mental health professional or with other patients in a group setting.

Even when medication relieves symptoms, psychotherapy can help address specific issues. These might include self-defeating ways of thinking; irrational fears; problems interacting with other people; or difficulty coping with situations at home, school, or work.
In general, the goals of psychotherapy are to gain relief from symptoms, maintain or enhance daily functioning, and improve quality of life.

grammar.sentence: Often, the type of treatment is tailored to the specific disorder.
grammar.explanation: is tailored是被动形式，说明治疗方式会按具体障碍作调整。主语the type of treatment是接受调整的对象；to引出调整所针对的情况。often不是always，因此不能从本句推出所有患者的流程完全相同。
grammar.quote: Often, the type of treatment is tailored to the specific disorder.

grammar.sentence: Even when medication relieves symptoms, psychotherapy can help address specific issues.
grammar.explanation: Even when表示“即使在……的时候也……”。句子承认药物可能缓解症状，同时说明心理治疗仍可能处理某些具体问题。can表示可能的作用，不是保证每个人有效，也不是说药物必然无效。
grammar.quote: Even when medication relieves symptoms, psychotherapy can help address specific issues.
